title: HF2796 (2025-2026 Regular): Right of the people to keep and bear arms protected, and constitutional amendment proposed.

provenance.fetched_by: Open States bulk data (Minnesota) (gun-policy Stage 5, Minnesota); operative text read by a Sonnet fill agent from the official Minnesota text (Introduction, 2025-03-25; official copy, https://www.revisor.mn.gov/bills/94/2025/0/HF/2796/versions/0/)
provenance.note: Introduced 2025-03-25. Proposes a constitutional amendment for the 2026 general election ballot, not a statute change.

operative_text:
Section 1 (Minn. Constitution, art. I, new section 18): A well regulated militia, being necessary to the security of a free state, the right of the people to keep and bear arms, shall not be infringed.
Section 2 (submission to voters): "Shall the Minnesota Constitution be amended to protect the right of the people to keep and bear arms?
